title: Balanced tensor and sheafification data before reciprocity
statement: Let R be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], on the small profinite site [def-weil-size-convention], and P a profinite group with closed subgroup H. Use the action-module categories of [def-sfb-condensed-action-module] and module sheafification of [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Present B_M(S) by finite formal sums of pairs (p,m), modulo additivity and R(S)-linearity in m and balancing (ph,m)=(p,hm). A TensorInductionPresheaf records the presheaf functor with these exact quotient sections, restrictions, functor maps and natural left multiplication action on generators. Its sheafTensor is the ordinary sheafification unit transported across a specified natural comparison. A TensorInductionSheafData records a functor L with this comparison, equivariance of the unit, the map formula on sheafified tensors, and an H-equivariant morphism identityTensor_M sending m to eta([1] tensor m). It does not include additivity, any Hom-set equivalence, any adjunction, or any extension property. TensorInductionSheafAdjunction is the original specification adding additivity and normalized adjunction formulas. All original definitions are moved verbatim, not chosen from an existence theorem.
